usage: The word '房' (fong2) is used to refer to a room in a house or building.
It is a noun and can be preceded by numbers or descriptors to specify which room (e.g., '三房' means 'three rooms').
You can use '房' to talk about bedrooms, living rooms, or any other types of rooms, but usually it is used for bedrooms or general rooms.
When combined with other words, '房' can form compound words that refer to specific types of rooms, like '睡房' for bedroom.
It can also be used in questions to ask about the number or type of rooms, for example, '你間屋有幾多個房？' (How many rooms does your house have?).
